One bug: the sitting is reported as over too early when it runs past midnight.

`is_over` (lines 21-23) treats any booking on an earlier day as over. A booking starting at 23:00 or 23:30 has a sitting that runs until 00:30 or 01:00 on the next day. At 00:10 on the next day, `self.slot.day < today` returns true, so a table still held is reported as over. Slots are half-hour and `Time` allows hours up to 23, so these late starts are possible. I did not check the bistro's opening hours, so whether such bookings occur in practice is unconfirmed. The tests only cover 17:00 on the following day, so they miss this.
